name: Tm Process Mining
pitch: See how work really flows through a process, and where it stalls, loops or splits.
question: Where do our Cases lose time, loop back or take a different route?
useWhen: Compare Cases, Variants, and Transitions in a Process.
features: Map every Activity and Transition on one picture.
Read each Case as a timeline.
Start from a template app with your own data.
Learn from two ready demo apps, Claims and Freight.

hero.alt: Five colored Lines run through an order process like routes on a transit map, with Case counts per Line.

screenshots.alt: Two groups of Cases drawn on one process map, with the routes only one group takes marked.
screenshots.caption: Two groups of Cases on one map: see which routes only one group takes.

screenshots.alt: Each Activity as a row showing where in a Case's lifecycle it first appears and repeats.
screenshots.caption: When each step usually happens in a Case, and where work repeats.

screenshots.alt: Demo App overview sheet: Case, Event and Variant counts, rework rate and Activity frequency.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: the Overview sheet shows where to look first.

screenshots.alt: Demo App Cases sheet: Journey Stripes, Case Timeline and Lifecycle beside a Case table and filters.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: three Extensions on one sheet show what makes up each Case.

screenshots.alt: Demo App Bottlenecks sheet: a Process Map coloured by Transition duration beside the slowest Transitions.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: a Process Map and charts that answer where Cases slow down.

screenshots.alt: Data model of the Demo App: Events, Cases, Transitions and Variants joined by CaseID and VariantID.
screenshots.caption: Data model: Events, Cases and Transitions join on CaseID; Variants on VariantID.

screenshots.alt: Demo App Variant Braids sheet: five Variant strands with a key, beside Process, Priority and Resource filters.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: five Variants as strands, so common and rare routes stand out.

screenshots.alt: Demo App Rework sheet: eleven named Activities and one arc that returns from Request Information to Credit Check.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: an arc marks where Cases return to an earlier step.

screenshots.alt: Demo App matrix sheet: a from-and-to grid of Activities with Case counts and marks for rare and backward steps.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: every step-to-step Transition in one grid, with rare ones marked.

screenshots.alt: Demo App Routes sheet: three colored Lines, one for each Priority, run through the order process.
screenshots.caption: In the Demo App: Cases grouped into Lines by Priority, meeting at shared steps.

screenshots.alt: Claims demo app overview: claim, median settlement and service target KPIs, claims per month and service target results by claim type.
screenshots.caption: In the Claims demo app: where do claims lose time? Start with volume and service targets.

screenshots.alt: Freight demo app Routes sheet: lines for shipments, containers, truck trips and customs entries meeting at shared Activities.
screenshots.caption: In the Freight demo app: follow the goods across Shipments, Containers and Customs entries.

screenshots.alt: Template app overview sheet: Case, Event and Activity counts and process measures for an example IT incident data set.
screenshots.caption: In the template app: the same sheets work with your own data after one script edit.

questions: Which routes do most Cases actually take?
Where does work go back and repeat?
How do two groups of Cases differ?
audience: Process owners and BI leads who want process insight inside Qlik Cloud apps.

featureStrips.heading: See the real process on one map
featureStrips.text: Activities and the Transitions between them show how many Cases take each route.
featureStrips.alt: Demo App Process sheet: a Process Map of the order process above Activity frequency and Transition duration charts.

featureStrips.heading: Compare the ways work gets done
featureStrips.text: Each Variant is a colored path, so the common routes and the odd ones stand out.
featureStrips.alt: Five colored Variant paths run through the process, with a legend of Case counts.

featureStrips.heading: Follow Cases line by line
featureStrips.text: Cases group into named Lines, like routes on a transit map, with counts at every Transition.
featureStrips.alt: Colored Lines run through the process like routes on a transit map.

featureStrips.heading: Trace one Case from start to end
featureStrips.text: Every Case is a row of Events over time, so slow Cases and long waits show at once.
featureStrips.alt: Five Cases as rows of Events with the time between them.

featureStrips.heading: Read many Cases at a glance
featureStrips.text: Each Case becomes a row of colored stripes, so patterns across many Cases are visible.
featureStrips.alt: Twenty Cases as rows of colored Activity stripes, longest first.

featureStrips.heading: Know when each step usually happens
featureStrips.text: Each Activity shows where in a Case's life it first appears and where it repeats.
featureStrips.alt: Each Activity as a row showing where in the Case lifecycle it occurs.

featureStrips.heading: Compare two groups of Cases
featureStrips.text: Put two Populations side by side and see which routes only one of them takes.
featureStrips.alt: Two Populations drawn on one map, with routes only one group takes marked.

featureStrips.heading: Find where work goes back
featureStrips.text: Backward and repeated Transitions stand out, so loops and rework are easy to find.
featureStrips.alt: A map where a thick arc marks four Cases going back to Credit Check.

featureStrips.heading: Check every Transition in a grid
featureStrips.text: A grid of from and to Activities shows the volume of each Transition, and the rare ones.
featureStrips.alt: A from-and-to grid of Activities with the Case count in each Transition.
